PCA outperformed the proposed score on the primary observation-detection endpoint in four configurations, with an inconclusive difference on Intel. In the 32-channel nonlinear configuration, attribution precision among the highest-ranked 10\% of screened candidates was 0.906 versus 0.719 for the selected PCA comparator. The paired difference interval was [0.047, 0.266]. This benefit reversed at broader coverage. No clear association-detection advantage was established.
